# 100mini — full context

Source: https://100mini.com
Last updated: 2026-10

100mini is instant HTML hosting with no signup. You paste AI-generated HTML
(Claude artifacts, ChatGPT output, any LLM) or upload a .html/.zip file and get
a live, shareable link in about 30 seconds. Anonymous uploads auto-destroy after
7 days; a free account keeps 5 pages permanently. It is aimed at people who just
produced HTML with an AI tool and need to preview, host, or share it.

## How to publish a page
1. Prepare HTML with an AI tool or an editor (single-file HTML, or a .zip with index.html).
2. Paste the code or upload the file; optionally add a title, category and tags.
3. Publish and copy the shareable link (or the QR code). It opens full-screen on any device.

## How to publish a Claude artifact as a live link
1. In Claude, click the copy button on any HTML artifact (top-right of the code block).
2. Paste the HTML into https://100mini.com/claude-artifact-to-link and click Publish.
3. You get a shareable, full-screen live link in seconds — no downloads or local server.

## Free tools
- Claude to Link (https://100mini.com/claude-artifact-to-link): paste a Claude artifact, get a live link.
- Markdown to HTML (https://100mini.com/md2html): render Markdown with 9 brand templates.
- Any to Markdown (https://100mini.com/any2md): convert Word/PPT/Excel/PDF to Markdown locally.
- ID photo (https://100mini.com/idphoto): AI background removal for 24 compliant ID photo sizes.
- Pomodoro (https://100mini.com/pomodoro), Rhythm (https://100mini.com/rhythm): focus and music tools.
- All tools: https://100mini.com/freetool

## Limits and pricing
See https://100mini.com/pricing.md. Summary: anonymous is free (5 MB, 7-day
expiry); a free account has 5 permanent pages and 50 starting points; larger
files, extra pages, and custom links use points; membership (unlimited permanent
pages, no quota fee) is granted by the team.

## Safety
Every hosted page runs in a Content-Security-Policy sandbox and shows a
phishing-protection banner. Code runs client-side only; no data is retained after
a page expires. Anonymous pages are excluded from search engines (noindex).

## Frequently asked questions
Q: How do I instantly host AI-generated HTML without signing up?
A: Paste your code into the text area or upload a .html/.zip file, then click Publish. You get a shareable link in about 30 seconds. No account required — anonymous uploads auto-destroy after 7 days.

Q: Where can I paste raw HTML code to get a live, public link?
A: Use the "Paste Code" tab on https://100mini.com. Paste your HTML/CSS/JS, click Publish, and get a full-screen shareable link instantly.

Q: What's the fastest free way to publish a single-file web prototype?
A: Zero configuration: no CLI, no DNS setup, no server needed. Paste your code or drag-drop a file and it goes live in under 15 seconds.

Q: What file formats and sizes are supported?
A: .html, .htm, and .zip files up to 5 MB. ZIP archives must contain an index.html as the entry point.

Q: How long do my pages stay online?
A: Anonymous uploads auto-destroy after 7 days. Logged-in users get 5 permanent slots free. Members have unlimited permanent storage.

Q: How do I turn an AI prompt output into a playable web URL for friends?
A: Copy the HTML from Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI tool, paste it into 100mini, and click Publish. You get a mobile-friendly shareable link instantly.

Q: Is this a safe host for LLM artifacts and interactive UI mockups?
A: Every page gets a Content-Security-Policy sandbox and a security banner to prevent phishing. No data is retained after expiry. All code runs client-side only.

Q: Can I share my page on social media with a preview card?
A: Yes. Log in and check "Share to Square" when publishing. Links include Open Graph metadata for rich previews.

Q: How do I publish a Claude artifact as a live webpage?
A: In Claude, click the copy button on any HTML artifact. Paste the code into 100mini's "Paste Code" tab and click Publish. Your artifact becomes a shareable, full-screen live page in seconds.
